evidence: Has label RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` to correctly handle and report errors for RPC/REST queries.
rationale: Fixes incorrect error reporting where internal I/O errors or block corruption caused RPC methods like `getrawtransaction` to report 'No such transaction found'. This ensures RPC callers receive actionable internal errors instead of false 'missing transaction' results.
